name: Vsevolod-Gabriel of Pskov
life: Holy Nobleborn Prince Vsevolod, baptized Gabriel (†1138), grandson of Vladimir Monomakh, ruled in Novgorod and later Pskov. He built churches, exhausted his treasury to relieve famine, and led victorious campaigns against pagan peoples. Unjustly banished by the Novgorodians, he was welcomed by Pskov, where he built the first stone church of the Holy Trinity. He reposed at age 46, mourned by all Pskov. His relics were transferred on April 22, 1834, the first day of Pascha.
